g.title: Queried only for model time (GET /modeltime), by the relock ticker
authz.go — ADR-001 precedence chain. Answers: is this permitted?
anomaly.go — deterministic rule-based scorer (unusual time, repeated attempts). Answers: is this unusual? Never reads the authorization result.
Combines authorization + anomaly into final_action (from authorization only) and alert (from anomaly only).
Hard constraint: only an ALLOW final_action may produce an UNLOCK command.
In-memory per-door pending state + relock timer (section 9.7). Lost on restart by design — see REQ-RES-004 evidence.

g.text: on ALLOW, arm the 10-model-second relock timer
